open_points.subject: owner-only start serving gate
open_points.text: “Until both listeners of step 4 are open, an opened one accepts no connection” contradicts “unless the start is owner-only” and “An owner-only instance: the owner interface served alone, no service API listener”
open_points.question: In an owner-only start, does the owner-interface listener begin accepting once that sole applicable listener is open, or does serving require two listeners even though the service-API listener is never created?
options: Treat “both listeners” as all listeners applicable to this start, so the owner interface starts accepting immediately after its listener opens.
Require literally both listeners, so an owner-only start never accepts an owner connection.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the gate as requiring every listener applicable to the selected start mode; for owner-only, that is the owner-interface listener alone.

witness.initial: A valid owner-only configuration has passed every check, and step 4 has opened the owner-interface listener; by definition no service-API listener will be opened.
events: An owner client connects to the owner-interface address.
outcomes: The connection is accepted and capability:owner_interface.serve_owner_request answers it because the only applicable listener is open.
The connection remains queued forever because the second listener required by the literal word “both” can never open.
witness.observer: The owner connecting to the owner interface

open_points.subject: startup listener queue exhaustion
open_points.text: “a connection that arrives meanwhile waits in the listener's queue”
open_points.question: What happens when connections arrive faster than the unopened surface can queue them and the listener's finite queue is full before serving begins?
options: Excess connections fail or are closed unanswered while already queued connections continue waiting.
Connection establishment blocks until queue space is available.
The start fails, closes every queued connection and performs the listener-failure cleanup.
Registry must configure a specified queue capacity large enough for a stated supported startup load.
open_points.default_guess: Use the platform listener backlog; when it is full, excess connections fail unanswered without failing the Registry start.

witness.initial: The owner-interface listener is open, the service-API listener has not yet opened, and the owner-interface listener's queue is full of waiting connections.
events: Another owner client attempts to connect before step 4 completes.
The service-API listener then opens successfully and the start reaches step 5.
outcomes: The new connection fails or is closed unanswered because the queue was full; the start still succeeds.
The new connection waits and is accepted after serving begins, because the text says a connection arriving meanwhile waits.
witness.observer: The owner client making the additional connection
